## ![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/common/images/main.png)

### Skyliner e-ticket Face Check in Go

#### About This Site

You can pre-purchase online discount tickets and set tickets for the Skyliner – a service that connects Narita Airport with the center of Tokyo in as little as 36 minutes – on this site.

By registering your face information after purchasing or settling payment, you can use the Face Check in Go services (boarding with facial recognition).

##### Skyliner Discount Ticket

###### ![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/top/images/title_skyliner.jpg)

You can purchase a discount ticket for the Skyliner service that operates between Narita Airport Station and Ueno Station.

\*Eligible for Face Check in Go (one-way only)

[Product information](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/eticket/index.html) [Purchase online](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/ticket/skyliner-ticket/index.php)

##### Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket

###### ![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/top/images/title_subway_ticket.jpg)

A ticket for the fast and comfortable Skyliner limited express, connecting Narita Airport to the heart of Tokyo in as little as 36 minutes\*1, and the "Tokyo Subway Ticket", which allows users to freely ride any Tokyo subway line for 24, 48 or 72 hours, all at a specially low priced set.

[Product information](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/tickets/subway.php) [Purchase online](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/ticket/skyliner-subway/index.php)

We at Keisei Electric Railway Co., Ltd. (“we”, “us”, “our” or “Keisei Electric Railway”) value your privacy and are committed to taking care of your Personal Data, which is a responsibility that we take very seriously.

This Privacy Policy explains how we may use the Personal Data we collect when you use the “Skyliner e-ticket” service (“Service”), visit our website (https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/, “Website”) in connection with the Service, purchase our products and/or services, inquire about our products and/or services, or subscribe to our marketing communications. This Privacy Policy applies to individuals residing outside of Japan.

Keisei Electric Railway is the data controller of the services offered through this website. Our registered office is at 3-3-1 Yawata, Ichikawa-shi, Chiba, Japan.

1\. Definitions

Unless otherwise indicated, terms used in this Privacy Policy are defined in appendix at the end of this Policy. Most of the definitions are derived from the EU General Data Protection which you can access from [here](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj).

2\. What type of Personal Data do we collect from you?

Personal Data means any information relating to you which allows us to identify you, either directly from that data or because we combine that information with other data about you.

When you use our Website, including booking services and/or products with us, subscribe to our marketing communications, or interact with us in relation to our services and/or products, you may provide us with your Personal Data, or we may obtain Personal Data about you.

We may process the following Personal Data:

- ▪ **Contact details and personal identifiers**：information such as your name, email address, telephone number, nationality, gender, and address.
- ▪ **Service and booking data**：information such as planned travel date, planned travel route, service usage amount, and other information related to the service being used.
- ▪ **Records of your interactions with us**：information such as contact history, content of inquiry, and other information provided during inquiries.
- ▪ **Prize campaign data**：information such as details of the application for the prize campaign, result of the prize selection, the shipping address for the prize to the winner, and social media account information.
- ▪ **Internet information**：including the date and time of your visit or use of our Website, IP address, URL of the webpages viewed, products and services browsed and searched for, Website activity, browsing time on the Website, device type and ID, OS, country of access, browser type and plug-ins, and other IT system identifying information.
- ▪ **Your marketing preferences**: so that we know whether and how we should contact you. You can stop receiving our marketing communications at any time, free of charge, through the methods displayed as part of any communication such as the unsubscribe link in our emails. Or further information on this please see the section 6. below.

3\. Where do we collect your Personal Data from?

We will collect Personal Data from several sources. These include the following:

**Directly from you**：when you use our Website, book our services and/or products, contact us by email or communicate with us directly in some other way.

**Our website**：provides us with information about how you use it and the devices that you use to connect to our Website. Like many other Websites, we use so-called “cookies”. Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (laptop, tablet, smartphone, etc.) when you visit our Website. If you have given your consent to our use of cookies, we do so to improve the use of our Website, analyse our Website or to display advertising on our Website. You can revoke your consent to our use of cookies any time.

In order to operate our Website and provide you with the services and products you have booked we may need to share your Personal Data with third parties. 9\. Data security

We take the security of your information very seriously and only handle Personal Data as permitted by data protection regulations. We use a variety of technical and organizational measures to help protect your Personal Data from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, loss or destruction in accordance with applicable data protection laws. When handling Personal Data, our employees are obliged to comply with the regulations of the GDPR.

10\. Your rights in relation to your Personal Data

You have the following rights in relation to your Personal Data：

- ▪ **Right of Access** \- you have the right to be informed about how we are using your Personal Data and the right to access that data that we hold about you.
- ▪ **Right to Erasure or "Right to be Forgotten"** \- you have the right to ask us to delete your Personal Data provided that there are no valid grounds for us to keep it, for example we may have to keep some or all of the Personal Data to comply with legal obligation or in respect of any legal claims.
- ▪ **Right to Data Portability** \- you have the right to receive the Personal Data you have provided to us in a digital format or in certain circumstances and where technically feasible the right to ask us to transmit the data to another organization.
- ▪ **Right of Rectification** \- you have the right to ask us to amend the Personal Data that we hold about you where believe it is inaccurate or incomplete.
- ▪ **Right to Object** \- in certain circumstances, you have the right to object to the processing of your Personal Data and to ask us to block, erase and restrict our use of your personal data.

- ▪ **Right of Limitation** \- you have the right to request the limitation of the Processing of your Personal Data, in the form of: (i) suspension of Processing or (ii) limitation of the scope of Processing to certain categories of Personal Data or purposes of Processing.
- ▪ **Right to lodge a complaint** \- you have the right to complain to the supervisory authority, in addition to us.

The exercise of rights is free of charge, except in the case of a manifestly unfounded or excessive request, in which case a reasonable fee may be charged regarding its costs. The period for handling a request is 30 days unless it is a particularly complex request.

Once our specified retention period has expired, we shall delete the relevant Personal Data. Therefore, the right to access, the right to erasure, the right to rectification and the right to data portability cannot be enforced after the expiration of such retention period.

Introducing the Keisei Group: Mt. Tsukuba

Hello! This is the Keisei Group!

Have you heard of the Keisei Group?...

The Keisei Group operates diverse businesses, including transportation, retail, and real estate, mainly in eastern Tokyo, Chiba Prefecture, and Ibaraki Prefecture. We support the lives of residents along our railway lines as a comprehensive lifestyle corporate group.

The Keisei Group also has some tourist spots to offer!

We would like to introduce one of the recommended tourist spots of the Keisei Group.

Let’s now take a look at Mt. Tsukuba ✨

Standing at an elevation of 877 meters in southern Ibaraki Prefecture, Mt. Tsukuba is one of the famous mountains in Japan. It is accessible by car in about an hour and a half from Tokyo Station or Narita Airport.

Mt. Tsukuba is served by a cable car and ropeway. The cable car takes you from Miyawaki Station (at an elevation of 305 meters) and Tsukuba-sancho Station (at an elevation of 800 meters) in approximately eight minutes. The ropeway takes you from Tsutsujigaoka Station (at an elevation of 542 meters) to Nyotai-san Station (at an elevation of 840 meters) in approximately six minutes. You can see Mt. Fuji, the highest mountain in Japan, and Tokyo Skytree from the summit on a clear day.

Tsukubasan Keisei Hotel is located right next to Tsutsujigaoka Station. Here, you can enjoy dynamic sunrises and sunsets, and spectacular night views that have been registered as a Night View Heritage of Japan. You can also relax in a hot spring and take in the scenery that extends out under your eyes from the open-air bath. (Day-use bathing is also available.)

Why not visit Mt. Tsukuba to enjoy spectacular scenery and hot springs?

### How to Use

[Print this page](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/index.html#)

#### How to use the e-ticket

Please use Face Check in Go by following this process.

【English】How to use the Skyliner e ticket Face Check in Go - YouTube

Tap to unmute

[【English】How to use the Skyliner e ticket Face Check in Go](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzI15T8ciQA) [Keisei Movies【京成電鉄公式チャンネル】](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmB0PAPD6YlIg3_TBHeWb6Q)

Keisei Movies【京成電鉄公式チャンネル】9.19K subscribers

[Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzI15T8ciQA)

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/e-ticket_pict-1.png)

After purchasing your e-ticket, use the camera app on your PC, smartphone, or other device to photograph your face and then upload the image to the Skyliner E-Ticket website to register it.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/e-ticket_pict-2.png)

At your starting station, go to a ticket gate equipped with Face Check in Go and turn your face to the screen of the terminal. At Nippori Station, only the north gate (Gate A) is equipped with Face Check in Go.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/e-ticket_pict-3.png)

Once Face Check in Go has authenticated your face, proceed through the gate. The ticket-vending machine will produce your train tickets. Anyone accompanying you on your journey should proceed through the gate with you.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/e-ticket_pict-4.png)

After checking your tickets, board the Skyliner service indicated on the ticket and sit in your designated seat.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/e-ticket_pict-5.png)

Keep hold of your tickets until you have reached your destination.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/e-ticket_pict-6.png)

At your destination station, go to a manned ticket gate and present your ticket to the attendant there (the tickets will not work with the automatic gates).

Please follow the procedure below to use the ticket you purchased.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/step01.png)

Please print out or save the information of the e-ticket you purchased and come to a ticket counter or limited express ticket machine designated by Keisei Electric Railway.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/step02.png)

Please present the e-ticket to the staff at the ticket counter and tell your desired departure time of Skyliner.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/step02_02.png)

Press the Code Exchange button on the limited express ticket machine screen and scan the exchange QR code over the reader.

After that, please select your desired departure time of Skyliner as indicated on the screen.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/step03.png)

You will be issued the number of tickets necessary to ride the Skyliner for the number of people in your party.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/step04.png)

Please go through the automatic ticket gate one by one with the tickets.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/usage/images/step05.png)

Please sit in your designated seat when you ride the Skyliner.

Please carry the tickets with you until you arrive at the destination.

#### About 3-D secure

This website uses VISA verification service and MasterCard SecureCode and AMEX American Express SafeKey and JCB J/Secure that provide high security so as to offer you safe shopping.

This service enables you to enter your code registered in advance on a window of the credit card company when paying with a credit card. This will guard you against unauthorized use of your credit card and give you added security for online shopping.

\\* To use this service, you need to register your code in the official web page of the credit card company in advance.

# Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket

- [![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/common/icon_acd_btm_white.png)About the Ticket](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/tickets/subway.php#anchor01)
- [![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/common/icon_acd_btm_white.png)Valid Period](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/tickets/subway.php#anchor03)
- [![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/common/icon_acd_btm_white.png)Price](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/tickets/subway.php#anchor04)
- [![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/common/icon_acd_btm_white.png)How to Purchase](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/tickets/subway.php#anchor05)

A ticket for the fast and comfortable Skyliner limited express, connecting Narita Airport to the heart of Tokyo in as little as 41 minutes\*1, and the Tokyo Subway Ticket, which allows users to freely ride any Tokyo subway line for 24, 48 or 72 hours, all at a specially low priced set.

- \*1 The fastest time (in minutes) between Keisei-Ueno station and Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 station by Skyliner.

## 1.About the Ticket

The Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket includes one-way or return fare between Narita International Airport and Keisei Ueno Station plus the Tokyo Subway (Toei Subway + Tokyo Metro Subway) Free Ticket (24 hours, 48 hours or 72 hours).

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/subway/about.jpg)

- \*Tickets are valid for six months from date of sale.

## 2.Valid Period

**24 hours 48 hours 72 hours**

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/subway/fare.jpg)

## 3.Price

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/subway/price.jpg)

- \*Skyliner one-way tickets may be used to ride either from Narita Airport towards the Ueno area or from the Ueno area to Narita Airport.
- \*Prices in brackets are children’s fares."Children" means passengers between the ages of 6 and 11.

## How to Purchase

### Purchasing online

・Skyliner e-ticket

[![Skyliner eticket](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/top/banner_e-ticket.png)](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/)

[![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/common/link_circle_red.png)Click here for Special Discount Tickets](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/)

・Available at Online Travel Agents

### Purchasing Aboard your flight

#### Step1

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/subway/pict01.jpg)

Purchase a voucher for the Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket aboard your low-cost-carrier flight.

#### Step2

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/subway/pict02.jpg)

After you arrive at Narita Airport, proceed to the Skyliner Ticket Counter or the Keisei Electric Railway Ticket Counter inside the Narita Airport terminal and present your receipt and voucher.

#### Step3

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/subway/pict03.jpg)

Enjoy sightseeing in Tokyo using the Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket !

\*Not available on flights which arrive at Narita Airport at 10:00 p.m. or later.

[![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/banner_springjapan.jpg)\[Spring Japan\]](http://en.ch.com/)

[![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/banner_peach.jpg)\[peach Aviation\]](http://www.flypeach.com/home.aspx)

\\* Sales are currently suspended.

##### Ticket exchange validity period

Limited to the day of sale. The Skyliner ticket will be valid for six months from the time of exchange. The Tokyo Subway Ticket will be valid for a 24, 48 or 72 consecutive hour period within six months.

## ![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/common/images/main.png)

### FAQ

#### Skyliner e-ticket FAQ

##### About this Service

What is Skyliner e-ticket?It is a service to purchase Skyliner and other tickets on the internet for non-Japanese citizens.Can everybody use the service?This service is provided only to non-Japanese citizens. However, customers with Japanese nationality can also use this service if they use Face Check in Go.May Japanese nationals residing abroad use this service when visiting Japan?This service is provided only to non-Japanese citizens. In principle, customers with Japanese nationality cannot use this service (except for those who use Face Check in Go).Can non-Japanese citizens use the service inside Japan?You may use the service if you are non-Japanese.Is the price the same even if I purchase a ticket at a station to use on the day?We sell Skyliner one-way tickets at non-discounted prices in stations. We do not sell Skyliner round-trip tickets in stations. The price of the Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket is the same if you purchase a ticket at a station to use on the day. However, when purchasing a ticket at a station to use on the day, it is only possible to pay in cash (Japanese yen).

##### Purchase

What is required to use Skyliner e-ticket?A. You can purchase with a credit card or Alipay+ or WeChat Pay. A passport is required when receiving the tickets.When is the purchase price deducted from the credit card?It is deducted when purchasing the tickets.From when can I purchase the tickets?The purchase may be made from 30 days prior to the day you wish to board a train.What is the maximum number of tickets which can be purchased at one time?Tickets for the total of 8 passengers may be purchased at one time, but only if reserving the same type of ticket.

However, Face Check in Go（Face recognition） can be used by up to 4 people. If you purchase for 5 or more, please bring your exchange number or exchange QR code to the counter.Can I purchase a Skyliner one-way ticket for one person and Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway ticket for one person at the same time?You need to purchase these separately by ticket type. You can only purchase one type of ticket at a time.Can I purchase just a Tokyo Subway Ticket?You can only purchase Skyliner one-way tickets, Skyliner round-trip tickets and Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Tickets (a Skyliner ticket and Tokyo Subway Ticket set) on this site. We do not sell just Tokyo Subway Ticket.Are all passengers required to enter email addresses?The information of one person as a representative will be enough.I have not received the confirmation email after the purchase. What should I do? It could happen that the email was not delivered due to typos in the entered email address or anti-spam measures. Please check the email address you entered. If there are no mistakes in the email address, then check the settings for your anti-spam measures. How can I inform my accompanying passengers of the information?Please click on the button \[Email information to accompanying passengers\] on purchase completed page. Then a mailer will start up. By entering the email address of the addressee, you may send her/him the purchase information.What is the maximum number of purchases per person?The maximum number of tickets which may be purchased at one time is 8 tickets (only if they are the same ticket type).

There are no limits on the number of purchases per person.

However,Face Check in Go（Face recognition） can be used by up to 4 people per use.Can I transfer the rights to others? No.

##### Ticket Reception/Boarding

Can I board the train at a station different from which I have designated when purchase?Yes. However, when using Face Check in Go, you cannot board stations other than the designated station. What is required when exchanging the tickets at a counter?The exchange number or a QR code and your passport to present when receiving the tickets. (However, when using Face Check in Go, you do not need to present your passport).If I have purchased a Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket, can I exchange the exchange number at Nippori Station and Keisei Ueno Station?No. If you have purchased a Keisei & Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket, you must exchange your exchange number for the ticket at the Narita Airport Station / Airport Terminal 2 Station Liner Ticket Sales Counter, the SKYLINER & KEISEI INFORMATION CENTER.If I have purchased a Keisei Skyliner round-trip ticket, can I exchange the exchange number at Nippori Station and Keisei Ueno Station?No, if you have purchased a Skyliner round-trip ticket, you must exchange your exchange number for the ticket at the Narita Airport Station / Airport Terminal 2 Station Liner Ticket Sales Counter, the SKYLINER & KEISEI INFORMATION CENTER.

##### Skyliner and other tickets

Can I board the Evening Line and Morning Liner with a Skyliner ticket?No.What trains can I ride with the Tokyo Subway Ticket?You can ride all lines on the Tokyo Metro and Toei Subway. Please ask a member of staff for more details.Do I need to specify a seat when using the Tokyo Subway Ticket?No.I will use the Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket, but do the day I use the Skyliner ticket and the day I use the Tokyo Subway Ticket have to be the same?No. However, you must use the Tokyo Subway Ticket within six months after you exchange it from the exchange number.If I will use the Skyliner round-trip ticket, when do I specify the seating position and car number on the Skyliner on the return trip?When you use the Skyliner round–trip ticket, we will give you a Skyliner ticket for your outward trip and an exchange ticket for your return trip. Before boarding the Skyliner on your return trip, please present this return trip exchange ticket and then tell a member of staff your desired seat position and car number.

##### Changes/Cancellation

What should I do if the number of passengers increases from when I made my purchase?Please display the “Purchase Information Details” page on this website, cancel the applicable purchase, and then make a new purchase again with the correct number of passengers.What should I do if the number of passengers decreases from when I made my purchase?The tickets will be issued in the actual number of passengers.I have purchased Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket one-way 24-hour ticket. However, can I change this to a Keisei Skyliner & Tokyo Subway Ticket round-trip 48-hour ticket?Please display the “Purchase Information Details” page from this site and then cancel the applicable purchase before making a new purchase.What if I want to cancel?Please go to "Purchase Information Details" page in this website and cancel the concerned purchase. When cancelling, please enter the PIN that was attached to the payment completed email.What if I want to change the day I board Skyliner.Please go to "Purchase Information Details " page in this website and cancel the concerned purchase.
What if I forgot the exchange number?Please go to " Purchase Information Details" page in this website and display the information of the concerned purchase to review the exchange number.I have purchased tickets for the section between Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station and Ueno Station with a Skyliner one-way ticket. Can I change the section on which I take Skyliner to the section between Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 Station and Nippori after the purchase?Yes. Please ask the staff for changing the section when receiving the tickets.What if I mistook "adult" for "child" when entering information?Please go to "Purchase Information Details" page in this website, cancel the concerned purchase and then make a new purchase again with the right classification of adult and child.Provided that we board the Skyliner at Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station and that one of us gets off at Nippori while another gets off at Ueno, what should we do?Please purchase tickets for Ueno and get off at Nippori.Can accompanying passengers board even if the representative person unexpectedly become unavailable?Accompanying passengers may not board if the representative person is unavailable. Please go to "Purchase Information Details" page in this website, cancel the concerned purchase and then make a new purchase again in the name of a person who is available.After purchasing, if the validity period expires without the tickets being received, will a refund be issued automatically?If the validity period expires, a refund cannot be issued. After purchasing, if the tickets are no longer needed, please cancel the applicable purchase within the validity period.

##### About Face Check in Go (Facial recognition)

What is Face Check in Go?With this service, registering your face information when purchasing a discount Skyliner ticket online means you do not need to exchange anything at the service counter of your boarding station, and lets you board a Skyliner by issuing a boarding ticket or limited express ticket for the nearest departing Skyliner by verifying your face when passing through the ticket gate. For details, please see the How to Use page. Which tickets can be used with Face Check in Go?Only one-way tickets can be used. If using Face Check in Go for a round trip, you need to buy separate one-way tickets for your outbound and return trips. What should I do when using Face Check in Go?Proceed with your purchase the same way as with a standard Skyliner e-ticket. You can use the Face Check in Go service by registering your face information after your purchase is completed, by using the camera function on your smartphone, personal computer, or other device on the face information registration page. Do I need to specify the number of tickets purchased when registering face information?Face information only for one representative is required when registering. When you verify your face when passing through the ticket gate at your boarding station, the purchased number of tickets will be issued, so everyone accompanying you can pass through together after the representative completes facial recognition.What should I do if I don’t want to register face information?We handle personal information in an appropriate manner in accordance with our company’s terms of use. However, if you do not register your face information, you cannot use Face Check in Go.What should I do if I want to change the boarding section?Display the purchase details screen from this site, and purchase again after cancelling your previous purchase. How can I board the train with Face Check in Go?Verify your face with the tablet installed at the ticket gate with facial verification at your boarding station. A ticket will be issued from the ticket machine after verification is completed. Take your ticket and arrive at your designated seat after boarding the Skyliner listed on the ticket. At Nippori Station, a ticket gate with facial verification is only installed at the northern ticket gate (Ticket gate A). For details, please see the How to Use page. Which Skyliners are designated for Face Check in Go?The tickets issued when passing through the ticket gate at your boarding station are designated for the most recent departing Skyliner at your boarding station. This does not apply for Skyliner trains that are full. With Face Check in Go, until how many minutes before departure is the most recent Skyliner designated?It is up to 2 minutes before departure with consideration to the time it takes to move there. If there are less than 2 minutes before departure, the next Skyliner is designated. Can I designate my own seat with Face Check in Go?You cannot designate your seat(s), but when you reserve seats for multiple passengers in a single application, adjacent seats that are next to each other will be designated. Please note that if the train is crowded then there are times when the adjacent seats will not be designated. If you want to designate your seat(s), please bring the exchange number or exchange QR code to the counter. With Face Check in Go, how do I depart my alighting station?Pass through the manned counter at each station.I registered my face information with Face Check in Go. What should I do if the Skyliner I want to board is not the one that is departing next?Bring your exchange number or exchange QR code to the counter.How can I board if I cannot use Face Check in Go?If for some reason you cannot use the Face Check in Go service or if service is suspended, bring your exchange number or exchange QR code to the counter.

[If the FAQs above do not solve your problem, please refer to the following URL.(English text only)\\

#### Skyliner Discount Ticket

##### About Keisei Skyliner

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/eticket/images/skyliner_about.jpg)

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/eticket/images/skyliner_about_sp.jpg)

The Keisei Skyliner is a high speed train that operates between Narita Airport and Ueno that offers comfortable passenger interiors. The Skyliner provides non-stop service to Nippori Station, which offers easy connections onto JR lines, as well as Ueno in the heart of downtown Tokyo. Passengers can travel between the airport and Tokyo without the hassle or stress of transfers or congestion. The Skyliner offers three services each hour. We invite you to discover the convenience and comfort of the Skyliner on your next visit to Japan.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/eticket/images/skyliner_routemap.jpg)

##### Interior

###### Open and spacious interior cabin

Ambient lighting produces a bright and crisp interior, while the high domed ceiling offers a sense of openness like few other passenger trains. The Skyliner's interior is so comfortable that passengers may not want to disembark after the quick 40-minute ride from Narita Airport to downtown Tokyo.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/eticket/images/photo_cabin.jpg)

###### Spacious vestibules

Doors separating the passenger cabin from the vestibule use glass materials that provide an open and clean look that also ensures bright lighting and a spacious feeling. Floors use Japan's traditional ichimatsu checkered pattern arranged in a wave-like design.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/eticket/images/photo_vestibules.jpg)

###### Comfortable seats

Ergonomically designed seats feature a large pitch of 41.3 inches (105 cm) and width of 18.5 inches (47 cm). Each seat also features its own power outlet that can be used to power personal computers or other devices.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/eticket/images/photo_seats.jpg)

###### Storage space for luggage

A spacious storage space for luggage is provided between the passenger cabin and vestibule of each car. Security cameras can also be found in each car, ensuring safety and peace of mind.

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/eticket/images/photo_luggage.jpg)

Keisei Skyliner connects Narita Airport with downtown tokyo in as little as 36 minutes.\*1 When you purchase Keisei Skyliner tickets online, through a designated travel agency or aboard your flight, the price is discounted.

- \*1: The fastest time (in minutes) between Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 station and Nippori station by Skyliner.

## Price

|     |     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | Standard Price | Discout Price |
| One way | Adults | ￥2,580 | ￥270 Discount￥2,310 |
| Children\*1 | ￥1,290 | ￥140 Discount￥1,150 |
| (Only possible to purchase on the Internet)Round Trip\*2 | Adults | ￥5,160 | ￥660 Discount￥4,500 |
| Children\*1 | ￥2,580 | ￥340 Discount￥2,240 |

- ＊1 "Children" means passengers between the ages of 6 and 11.
- ＊2 If you purchase a Skyliner round-trip ticket, the ticket may be exchanged only at Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station and Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 Station. Tickets may not be exchanged at Ueno Station or Nippori Station.

## How to Purchase

### Purchasing online

・Skyliner e-ticket

[![Skyliner eticket](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/top/banner_e-ticket.png)](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/)

[![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/common/link_circle_red.png)Click here for Special Discount Tickets](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/e-ticket/en/)

・Available at Online Travel Agents

### Purchase in Tokyo: Skyliner Value Ticket

#### Step1

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/pict04.jpg)

Purchase in Tokyo: This ticket is for the Skyliner in a one-way direction from Ueno Station/Nippori Station to Narita Airport.

#### Step2

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/pict02.jpg)

Please bring this ticket to Keisei Ueno Station (Ticket Counter) or Nippori Station (JR Connection Counter) and get a seat reservation on your desired train. When exchanging a ticket at Nippori Station, please present this together with your JR line passenger ticket up to Nippori Station or IC card. The Skyliner operates a full seat reservation system.

#### Step3

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/pict03.jpg)

Exchange the voucher and then take the Skyliner!

[![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/banner_tobu.jpg)\[TOBU Tourist Information Center ASAKUSA\]](http://www.tobu.co.jp/foreign/en/tourist/)

Hours of sale 7:20 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.

[![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/banner_seibu.jpg)\[SEIBU Tourist Information Center Ikebukuro\]](http://www.seibu-group.co.jp/railways/tourist/english/information/)

Hours of sale 8:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m.

##### Where to exchange the coupon

- ・Keisei Ueno Station (Ticket Counter) or Nippori Station (JR Connection Counter)

##### Ticket exchange validity period

This is limited to the day of sale. Please make sure to exchange your ticket by the Skyliner departure time. The counter may become crowded just before departure, so please arrive with time to spare.

### Purchase aboard your flight

#### Step1

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/pict05.jpg)

Purchase a voucher for the Skyliner Value Ticket aboard your low-cost-carrier flight.

#### Step2

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/pict02.jpg)

After you arrive at Narita Airport, proceed to the Skyliner Ticket Counter or the Keisei Electric Railway Ticket Counter inside the Narita Airport terminal and present your receipt and voucher.

#### Step3

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/pict03.jpg)

Take the ticket you receive in exchange for the voucher and board the Skyliner!

\*Not available on flights which arrive at Narita Airport at 10:00 p.m. or later.

[![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/banner_springjapan.jpg)\[Spring Japan\]](http://en.ch.com/)

[![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/banner_peach.jpg)\[peach Aviation\]](http://www.flypeach.com/home.aspx)

\\* Sales are currently suspended.

[![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/banner_hkexpress.jpg)\[Hong Kong Express Airways\]](https://www.hkexpress.com/en-hk/)

##### Where to exchange the coupon

- ・Skyliner Ticket Counter (Narita Airport Terminal 1 Stn./Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 stn.)
- ・SKYLINER & KEISEI INFORMATION CENTER

- \*The Skyliner Value Ticket may be used one-way from Narita Airport Terminal 1 Stn. or Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 Stn. to Nippori Stn. or Keisei Ueno Stn.

##### Ticket exchange validity period

Limited to the day of sale

### How to Purchase at Regional Airports

#### Step1

![](https://www.keisei.co.jp/keisei/tetudou/skyliner/us/assets/images/tickets/coupon/pict06.jpg)
